caseNameFull: Maher El Falesteny v. Barack H. Obama, President of the United States

opinions.text:
Motion for leave to file a petition for writ of certiorari under *974seal denied without prejudice to filing a renewed motion together with either a redacted petition, or an explanation as to why the petition may not be redacted, within 30 days.

Justice Kagan took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
